name: Bishesh Khanal
summary: Civil Engineering graduate with first-author research in flood inundation modelling and precipitation extremes. Experienced in HEC-RAS 2D, HEC-HMS, GIS, and Python-based machine learning for hydrological prediction.
role: Civil engineer. Flood modelling, hydrology and machine learning for early warning.
statement: My research combines flood simulation, machine learning and mapping to understand who is exposed to flooding and whether they get warning early enough to reach safety. I work in Nepal, where steep basins, few gauges and dense settlement make this hard.
